subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “After a typhoon damaged phone networks, a small community radio station became important.”?
options: Many people became frightened and bought extra supplies.
Her voice shook, but people listened quietly.
Many young people had never listened to it before.
Many young people used the app before holidays.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Many people became frightened and bought extra supplies.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Her voice shook, but people listened quietly.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Many young people had never listened to it before.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Many young people used the app before holidays.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Many young people had never listened to it before.」，答案為「Many young people had never listened to it before.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Many young people had never listened to it before.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
